mapper.sql: select r.record_id, r.record_no, r.plan_id, r.elevator_id, r.maintain_type, r.plan_date, r.executor_id, r.clock_in_time, r.clock_in_location, r.execute_date, r.execute_result, r.abnormal_desc, r.normal_count, r.abnormal_count, r.na_count, r.record_status, r.del_flag, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time, e.elevator_code as elevator_code, e.unit_no as unit_no, b.building_no as building_no, c.community_name as community_name, u.nick_name as executor_name from inspection_record r left join elevator e on r.elevator_id = e.elevator_id left join building b on e.building_id = b.building_id left join community c on b.community_id = c.community_id left join sys_user u on r.executor_id = u.user_id
mapper.select: select count(1) from inspection_record where del_flag = '0' and plan_id = #{planId} and plan_date = #{planDate}

select count(1) as totalCount, ifnull(sum(normal_count), 0) as normalSum, ifnull(sum(normal_count + abnormal_count + na_count), 0) as itemSum from inspection_record where del_flag = '0' and elevator_id = #{elevatorId} and record_status = 'finished' and plan_date >= #{beginTime} and plan_date <= #{endTime}
select count(1) from inspection_record where del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into inspection_record ( record_no, plan_id, elevator_id, maintain_type, plan_date, executor_id, record_status, execute_result, del_flag, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{recordNo}, #{planId}, #{elevatorId}, #{maintainType}, #{planDate}, #{executorId}, ifnull(#{recordStatus}, 'pending'), ifnull(#{executeResult}, 'pending'), '0', #{createBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.select: select ir.result_id, ir.record_id, ir.item_id, ir.item_name, ir.item_category, ir.check_result, ir.abnormal_desc, ir.file_id, ir.order_num, mi.check_standard as check_standard, f.file_name as file_name from inspection_item_result ir left join maintain_item mi on ir.item_id = mi.item_id left join sys_file f on ir.file_id = f.file_id and f.del_flag = '0' where ir.record_id = #{recordId} order by ir.order_num, ir.result_id
mapper.insert:
insert into inspection_item_result ( record_id, item_id, item_name, item_category, check_result, abnormal_desc, file_id, order_num ) values
(#{item.recordId}, #{item.itemId}, #{item.itemName}, #{item.itemCategory}, #{item.checkResult}, #{item.abnormalDesc}, #{item.fileId}, #{item.orderNum})
mapper.sql: select a.archive_id, a.elevator_id, a.archive_type, a.maintain_type, a.biz_id, a.archive_time, a.summary, a.executor_name, a.execute_date, a.is_abnormal, a.create_time, e.elevator_code as elevator_code, e.unit_no as unit_no, b.building_no as building_no, b.community_id as communityId, c.community_name as community_name from maintain_archive a left join elevator e on a.elevator_id = e.elevator_id left join building b on e.building_id = b.building_id left join community c on b.community_id = c.community_id
mapper.select: where a.elevator_id = #{elevatorId} order by a.execute_date desc, a.archive_id desc
select count(1) from maintain_archive where archive_type = #{archiveType} and biz_id = #{bizId}
mapper.insert: insert into maintain_archive ( elevator_id, archive_type, maintain_type, biz_id, archive_time, summary, executor_name, execute_date, is_abnormal, create_time ) values ( #{elevatorId}, #{archiveType}, #{maintainType}, #{bizId}, sysdate(), #{summary}, #{executorName}, #{executeDate}, ifnull(#{isAbnormal}, '0'), sysdate() )
